notes.title: News + Updates
notes.content:
Hello!

Receiving lot of feedback so now changed firstly few stuff:

- Camera changed little bit, it can still rotated via mouse, but not so much anymore. Later after feedback I will change it more if needed

- Player/driver character changed more realistic human character. Still some collision problem and next start to study that problem

notes.title: Feedback and suggestions
notes.content:
Hello dear community

During feedback what I have got, i start to gather feedback what would be change and what would be add later to this project

- Camera will possible changed in future so it will follow player. Current camera system is better maybe for open world style maps

- I have started to consider some other gamemodes later, like adding health system and weapons to kart car so it can be more enjoyable
